[PAPER_0039, relevance_score=0.384] Sample Selection and Exclusion Criteria

Across all our studies, we restricted our samples to only U.S. participants on both Qualtrics and CloudResearch (Litman et al., 2017), and those who were not using mobile devices to respond to our surveys. We further excluded non-U.S. IP addresses using a manual lookup of the sample IPs. This latter manual exclusion was not preregistered. In the online supplemental materials , we provide results using no exclusion criteria, as well as extended exclusion criteria that removed participants flagged as suspicious by the application developed in Kennedy et al.
